New York and Dubai, November 20, 2026 – VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON), a global digital operator, today announced that the full recording, presentation materials and photo highlights of its 2026 Capital Markets Day are now available on demand at veoncmd.com.

The event took place on November 16, 2026, at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York. The day opened with VEON’s management team ringing the Nasdaq Opening Bell to mark the 30th anniversary of the company’s US listing.

More than 50 external investors and analysts attended the Capital Markets Day that followed in person, and more than 70 further external participants joined the live webcast.

Under the vision “VEON 2030: A Better Life for All,” the company’s management team presented the Group’s strategy and its 2030 financial framework. This framework builds towards the following targets:

  • Growth: 12–15% organic annual growth in USD revenue and EBITDA, 2026 to 2030
  • Earnings and cash flow: earnings per share and free cash flow growing faster than revenue
  • Shareholder returns: at least USD 200 million annually, through share buybacks and cancellation
  • Balance sheet discipline: net leverage at or below 1.5x, excluding leases

VEON also aspires to increase its mix of digital services to approximately 50% of Group revenue by 2030, from 27.2% in the 3Q26, by combining organic growth with selective acquisitions. The Group’s 2030 growth target above is on an organic basis.

Kaan Terzioğlu, Group CEO at VEON said: “We were delighted by the strong engagement from investors and analysts, both in the room and online, at our Capital Markets Day 2026. During the event, we set out how telecom remains the foundation of our business, but it is not the destination. A year ago, digital services made up approximately a fifth of our revenue. Today it’s more than a quarter, and climbing every quarter we report. We’ve paired that growth with real capital discipline: raised guidance, an active share buyback, and a stronger balance sheet funding what comes next. For anyone who could not join us, the full presentations are now available, and we look forward to continuing the conversation with you as we build towards our next phase of growth.”

Explore the full Capital Markets Day at veoncmd.com

Visitors can access the full presentations and Q&A sessions, session materials, event highlights, and the VEON CEO’s AI Digital Twin - an interactive experience designed to help analysts and investors explore VEON’s published strategy and CMD content.

VEON is a digital operator that provides connectivity and digital services to over 150 million connectivity users and more than 221 million digital customers. Operating across five countries - that are home to 550 million consumers, more than 6% of the world's population, VEON is transforming lives through technology-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth. Tokyo, Japan, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. (“Tokyo Lifestyle” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: TKLF), a retailer and wholesaler of Japanese beauty and health products, sundry products, luxury products, electronic products, collectible cards, trendy toys as well as other products in Hong Kong, Japan, North America, Thailand, Vietnam, the United Kingdom and Australia, today announced the planned opening of a new store under its proprietary “Reiwatakiya” brand (the “Store”) in London, the United Kingdom, on November 21, 2026. This expansion marks another important milestone in the Company’s ongoing efforts to strengthen its UK retail presence, broaden its customer reach, and enhance its international sales network.

A Prime Retail Location in an Iconic Shopping Destination

Located at Westfield London, one of the largest shopping centers in the UK and Europe, the new Reiwatakiya Store is expected to benefit from substantial shopper traffic and a diverse international customer base. Supported by convenient transportation links, including underground, rail, and road networks, Westfield London and its surrounding area attract approximately 27.9 million visitors annually. The shopping center generates approximately £1 billion in annual retail sales, underscoring its position as a leading commercial and retail destination in London.

The Store will showcase Tokyo Lifestyle’s diverse selection of authentic Japanese beauty and lifestyle products, selected Korean beauty brands. Strategically situated next to Zara and Apple stores, the Store is positioned to attract a broad consumer audience, particularly younger shoppers who represent an important target demographic for the Company.

To celebrate its grand opening on November 21 and 22, the Store will host special promotional activities, including a limited-time Japanese beauty goodie bag giveaway. These initiatives are designed to attract initial customer traffic, build brand awareness and foster engagement with local consumers. For more details about the grand opening event, please visit https://reiwatakiya.co.uk/.

The new Store will complement Tokyo Lifestyle’s existing London location in the city center, strengthening its retail presence in distinct commercial areas across the city. Together, these locations are expected to enhance the Company’s brand visibility, broaden its access to local consumers and international visitors, and provide a stronger operating foundation for potential expansion into other European markets.

Advancing Global Expansion Through a Distinctive Retail Brand Strategy

The Company’s UK expansion forms part of its broader global growth strategy, guided by its commitment to bringing authentic Japanese beauty and lifestyle products, distinctive cultural experiences, and emerging consumer trends to customers worldwide. In recent years, Tokyo Lifestyle has accelerated the expansion of its international retail operations, with its latest physical store opening in Sydney in October 2026.

Alongside its expanding international retail footprint, the Company continues to pursue greater revenue diversification and brand development through a combination of directly operated stores, franchise partnerships, and wholesale distribution channels. These initiatives are intended to strengthen its international market presence, broaden its customer base, and establish a more diversified and scalable global business platform.

Mr. Mei Kanayama, Principal Executive Officer of Tokyo Lifestyle, commented: “The opening of our new Reiwatakiya store in the UK represents an important milestone in our long-term commitment to the UK and broader European markets. London has long served as a strategic gateway for our European expansion, and establishing two retail locations in distinct commercial areas across the city will enable us to reach a wider customer base, strengthen our brand recognition, and further develop our local operating capabilities.

“We have made a meaningful long-term commitment to this location, reflecting our confidence in the commercial potential of Westfield London and the continued appeal of Japanese beauty and lifestyle products among international consumers. Beyond adding another retail location, we see this Store as an opportunity to further refine our retail positioning, deepen customer engagement, and strengthen our understanding of local consumer preferences. Looking ahead, we intend to leverage our growing presence in London as a foundation for exploring additional opportunities across the UK and Europe, while continuing to build a distinctive and internationally recognized retail brand. We believe our expanding global retail network, combined with our diversified product portfolio and multi-channel business model, will position Tokyo Lifestyle to capture emerging market opportunities and generate sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.”

Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. (formerly known as Yoshitsu Co., Ltd) is a retailer and wholesaler of Japanese beauty and health products, sundry products, luxury products, electronic products, collectible cards, trendy toys, and other products in Hong Kong, Japan, North America, Thailand, Vietnam, the United Kingdom and Australia. VANCOUVER, Wash.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, today announced that Qualified from Salesforce has upgraded its ZoomInfo integration to the ZoomInfo GTM.AI API. Qualified now enriches website visitor profiles through the API's company and contact enrichment endpoints, replacing the legacy WebSights and Enterprise APIs, so Piper, Qualified's agent, works from verified ZoomInfo company and contact data.

For Qualified customers, the integration works as it did before. They connect their ZoomInfo account in Qualified, and visitor profiles are enriched automatically, with no change to their setup.

The integration enriches each website visitor at two points. When a visitor arrives on a customer's website, Qualified uses reverse IP enrichment to add ZoomInfo company data to the visitor's profile. When a visitor shares an email address, Qualified uses email enrichment to add ZoomInfo contact data.

Both enrichment steps run automatically, at the same two points every time. The data flows into Qualified visitor fields, the context Qualified holds on each website visitor. Customers choose which fields Piper can use in conversations and which fields drive deterministic workflows such as segmentation and routing.

The API gives partners and customers programmatic access to ZoomInfo's verified company and contact data. The Qualified integration uses two of its endpoints, company enrichment and contact enrichment, and only the fields those endpoints return.

Customers connect the integration with their existing ZoomInfo account.

“Qualified customers already generate pipeline with Piper,” said Dennis Sevilla, Chief Strategy Officer at ZoomInfo. “ZoomInfo adds verified company and contact data to every visitor profile. Piper starts each conversation knowing more about who she is talking to, and teams can segment and route visitors on data they trust.”

Qualified customers can connect ZoomInfo from the Qualified settings page at app.qualified.com/settings/zoominfo. Customers who do not see the option can contact their Qualified Success Architect (QSA). Details are also available on the ZoomInfo integrations page at zoominfo.com/integrations/qualified.

The upgrade puts Qualified on the same GTM.AI API that ZoomInfo partners use to bring verified company and contact data into their platforms.

About ZoomInfo

ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.

GTM.AI is a headless layer that connects to ZoomInfo's GTM Context Graph. It is the API and Model Context Protocol home for AI agents, powering integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft, Anthropic, OpenAI, Perplexity, and dozens more.

Learn more at zoominfo.com and gtm.ai.

apitechnical
An API, or Application Programming Interface, is a set of rules that allows different software programs to communicate and work together smoothly, much like a waiter translating your order into the kitchen and then bringing your meal back. For investors, it provides clarity on how predictions or assessments are made, increasing confidence in decision-making.

As vehicle architectures become more electrified and software-defined, automakers face growing demands on the systems that power safety-critical and high-performance electrical functions. The Flex HV DC/DC Converter addresses these challenges with a scalable, bidirectional architecture that supports both 400V and 800V traction battery systems and responds quickly to dynamic vehicle loads.

"Winning a third PACE Award in two years is an honor and a testament to Flex's continued innovation in automotive power and compute," said Andreas Heim, Vice President of Automotive at Flex. "This latest recognition highlights our expanding capabilities across both high- and low-voltage power systems as automakers move toward increasingly sophisticated electrified vehicle architectures."

The DC/DC platform uses a dual active bridge-based architecture to provide wide input-voltage capability and bidirectional energy flow. By responding dynamically to changing electrical demands, it can help automakers simplify electrical architectures, reduce reliance on auxiliary low-voltage energy storage, and improve system reliability. It also supports higher-power applications and integration with onboard chargers, inverters, and software-defined power management.

The award builds on Flex's 2025 PACE Award for its Backup DC/DC Converter, which provides power continuity for essential drive-by-wire systems. The Automotive News PACE Awards recognize automotive supplier innovations that demonstrate significant technological advancement and business impact, as selected by an independent panel of judges.

Mercury Insurance explains what drivers should do before starting a flooded vehicle and how comprehensive auto coverage may help.

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mercury Insurance (NYSE/NYSE TX: MCY) urges drivers whose cars have flooded to leave the engine off, even if the seats feel dry and the dashboard lights come on. Water can reach wiring beneath the carpet or enter the engine, and starting the car can make the damage worse. A qualified technician should inspect the vehicle before anyone attempts to drive it.

"It's a natural reaction to reach for the keys. You need to get to work, the water is gone and you want to know if the car still runs," said Michael Curcio, vice president of claims at Mercury Insurance. "Before starting your vehicle, take a moment to safely assess both your surroundings and the vehicle itself. If the vehicle was exposed to floodwater, starting it could be unsafe and may cause additional damage. Look for signs of water intrusion, such as mud, debris, or visible waterlines, and contact your insurer to report what you find. If possible, take photos showing how high the water reached. Even a simple photo of the waterline on the door can help your claims representative understand the situation and guide you through the next steps."

El Niño is currently helping to support an active pattern of atmospheric rivers across the West, including California. Atmospheric rivers can cause repeated rounds of heavy rain and widespread flooding. (https://www.noaa.gov/stories/what-are-atmospheric-rivers)

"If your garage, street or parking area has flooded before, choose another place to park before the storm arrives. Keep an eye on your local forecast and treat a flood watch or flood warning as a signal to move your car to higher ground" said Stephen Bennett, head of climate and catastrophe science at Mercury Insurance.

What to do if your car floods

  • Leave the vehicle off. If water entered the cabin or you suspect it reached the engine, skip the test drive, even a short one to the repair shop. Ask your insurer about towing and inspection. Electrical connections can corrode after the interior dries, so a problem may take time to appear.
     
  • Document what you can see safely. Wait until the water recedes and the area is safe to approach. Before cleaning up, photograph the vehicle, any visible waterline and the surrounding area. Note where the car was parked and approximately when the flooding occurred. Keep receipts for towing or storage.
     
  • Tell the tow operator if the vehicle is electric or hybrid. A flood-damaged high-voltage battery can pose a shock or fire risk. Leave the vehicle off, avoid plugging it in and contact the dealer for guidance. If you see smoke, sparks or flames, move away and call 911. Tell the dispatcher an electric or hybrid vehicle is involved.

Does auto insurance cover flood damage?

Comprehensive auto coverage generally helps pay for flood damage to the insured vehicle, subject to the policy's deductible and terms. Drivers can check the declarations page of their auto policy to see whether they carry comprehensive coverage on the affected car and which deductible applies. Liability-only coverage does not pay for flood damage to the driver's own vehicle.

Insurance coverage is subject to the terms, conditions, exclusions, limits and deductibles of the applicable policy. Roadside assistance and other optional coverages may not be included in every policy. This information is provided for general educational purposes and does not modify or expand coverage under any insurance policy.

For information about auto coverage, visit the Mercury Insurance Resource Center.

Mercury Insurance (NYSE/NYSE TX: MCY) is a multiple-line insurance carrier predominantly offering personal auto, homeowners, renters and commercial insurance through a network of independent agents in Arizona, California, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Oklahoma, Texas and Virginia, as well as auto insurance in Florida. Mercury writes other lines of insurance in various states, including commercial, business owners and business auto, landlord, home-sharing, ride-hailing and mechanical protection insurance.

Since 1962, Mercury has provided customers with tremendous value for their insurance dollar by pairing ultra-competitive rates with excellent customer service, through more than 4,200 employees and a network of more than 6,340 independent agents in 11 states. The brief connects the company’s sustainability efforts with the operational priorities that matter to customers: reliable service, efficient freight movement and better visibility into supply chain emissions.

“For 70 years, Werner has helped keep America moving by investing in our people, our equipment and the service we deliver,” said Werner’s Chairman and CEO, Derek Leathers. “We are almost halfway to our goal of a 55% reduction in CO₂ emissions by 2035 against our 2020 baseline. Our sixth annual sustainability report highlights the practical investments in fleet efficiency, technology and emissions reporting that support our continued progress and help our customers meet their sustainability goals.”

Key highlights from the 2026 Sustainability Brief include:

  • Fleet Decarbonization & Equipment Innovation: Advanced a practical, multi-pathway decarbonization strategy by evaluating and piloting diverse low- and zero-emission technologies and fuels.
  • Emissions Reduction & Expanded Reporting: Achieved a 27% reduction in CO2 emissions relative to its 2020 baseline. Expanded transparency by refining Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG accounting controls and disclosing Scope 3 supply chain emissions for the first time.
  • Waste Reduction & Environmental Stewardship: Utilized the Waste and Energy Scorecard to track resource efficiency, conserving more than 619,000 gallons of oil through tire retreading, recycling more than 850,000 pounds of metal and returning nearly 14,000 battery cores to production loops.
  • Strengthened Governance & Global Frameworks: Aligned reporting with SASB standards, UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and CDP climate disclosures. Established a formal Greenhouse Gas Inventory Management Plan (IMP) to prepare for future limited assurance reporting and mandatory compliance requirements.

Key Terms

scope 1technical
Scope 1 are the greenhouse gas emissions a company produces directly from sources it owns or controls, like fuel burned in company vehicles, boilers, or on-site factories. Think of it as the smoke coming out of a business’s own chimney versus electricity it buys from the grid. Investors watch Scope 1 because these direct emissions can create regulatory costs, operational changes, and reputational risks that affect profitability and long-term value.
scope 2technical
Scope 2 covers the greenhouse gas emissions produced indirectly when a business uses energy it buys from others—most commonly electricity, but also steam, heating or cooling. Think of it like the pollution linked to your household’s electricity bill: you didn’t burn the fuel yourself, but your consumption still causes emissions. Investors watch Scope 2 because it affects a company’s climate footprint, energy costs, regulatory exposure and reputation, all of which can influence long‑term financial performance.
scope 3technical
Scope 3 describes all greenhouse gas emissions that occur upstream and downstream of a company’s direct operations—things like emissions from suppliers, transportation, product use, and disposal. Think of it as the hidden carbon footprint tied to everything a business buys, sells, or enables; it matters to investors because these indirect emissions can drive regulatory costs, supply-chain disruption, consumer preference shifts, and long-term valuation risk that aren’t visible on a company’s factory floor or utility bill.
limited assuranceregulatory
An engagement where an independent auditor or reviewer provides moderate confidence that financial or non-financial information is free from material misstatement, but stops short of a full audit. Think of it as a focused check or review that uncovers obvious errors but does not involve the deep testing of a full audit. It matters to investors because it signals a lower level of independent verification of reported numbers, helping them judge how much trust to place in the disclosed information.

COLUMBUS, Ohio, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Northwest Bank and the Center of Science and Industry (COSI) are helping Central Ohio students build practical financial skills and explore careers in banking through a new series of hands-on learning experiences.

The partnership officially launched at Ridgeview Middle School with a COSI HIVE (Human Innovation Experience) experience, a hands-on program that introduces students to real-world skills and careers through interactive activities. At the event, approximately 150 students went through five interactive stations led by COSI educators and Northwest Bank volunteers. At each station students explored financial concepts. They practiced budgeting while selecting materials to make slime and learned about risk management through a block-building exercise.

"Financial literacy is one of the most important life skills we can help foster in the communities we serve," said Devin Teles-Cygnar, chief marketing and communications officer and Northwest Bank Charitable Foundation president. "By teaming up with COSI, we have an opportunity to engage students in a meaningful way that helps build confidence, encourages curiosity and opens doors to future possibilities. Together, we're creating opportunities that help communities thrive."

Through a $125,000 contribution, Northwest will support additional HIVE events in four other Central Ohio communities served by the bank. 

"COSI believes learning is most powerful when it is relevant, engaging and connected to real-world opportunities and money is one of the first places young people engage in math in everyday life," said Dr. Frederic Bertley, president and CEO of COSI. "The HIVE-Fin-Lit edition was created on the premise that students deserve to see what is possible in the fields of mathematics, actuarial sciences and finance. Together with Northwest Bank, we can help students build financial confidence, explore future careers and develop the skills they need to succeed in our rapidly changing world. We are grateful to Northwest Bank for partnering with COSI to bring this important educational opportunity to students in the hometown we share."

Northwest will also support the development of a financial literacy learning kit created by COSI and the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland. The kit is designed to help families build practical skills in budgeting, saving, decision-making and financial planning.

This effort builds on Northwest's growing investment in Central Ohio. The bank recently opened its third Columbus financial center on Bethel Road, with new centers planned in Gahanna in December and Westerville in the first quarter of 2027 and a 75,000‑sq‑ft, purpose‑built corporate headquarters in Dublin, OH with relocation planned for 2029.

About Northwest Bank

Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Northwest Bancshares, Inc. is the bank holding company of Northwest Bank. Founded in 1896, Northwest Bank is a full-service financial institution offering a complete line of business and personal banking products, as well as employee benefits and wealth management services. Currently, Northwest operates more than 150 full-service financial centers and 11 drive-up locations across Pennsylvania, New York, Ohio, and Indiana and provides customers fee-free access to more than 55,000 ATMs. Additional information regarding Northwest Bancshares, Inc. and Northwest Bank can be accessed online at www.northwest.bank. 

About COSI

COSI, ranked "#1 Science Museum in the Country" six of the last seven years as voted by USA TODAY's 10Best, is an esteemed science center that has delighted Central Ohio with all things science for 60 years, inspiring interest in science, technology, engineering, arts, and math (STEAM) topics and delivering our experiential, "hands-on fun" brand of learning. COSI has been awarded 15 Emmy® Awards for its effective science communication television and video productions impacting science literacy for people of all ages. As a trusted educational resource for families, schools, and community partners, COSI is an essential element of our regional, national, and international communities, engaging millions of people annually through onsite, offsite, and online experiences. Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 20, 2026) - Metaguest.AI Incorporated (CSE: METG) ("Metaguest" or the "Company"), an AI technology company transforming the hospitality sector through intelligent guest engagement, announces its unaudited financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with the results of its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders held on November 19, 2026.

Metaguest reported EBITDA of $197,733 for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 99.2% from $99,273 in the second quarter, marking its second consecutive quarter of positive EBITDA. Adjusted EBITDA for the third quarter was $190,179. EBITDA for the corresponding quarter of 2025 was $(328,288).

The Company also recorded net income of $66,734 for the third quarter, compared with a net loss of $494,449 in Q3 2025.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, EBITDA improved to $237,282, compared with $(858,506) in 2025. Adjusted EBITDA was $220,613. The Company's nine-month net loss decreased by approximately 86%, from $1,305,425 to $180,748.

These improvements reflect the Company's ongoing cost-management initiatives, organizational changes and strengthened financial oversight.

Management Commentary

"With a more disciplined operating structure in place, we are now focused on advancing our technology, enhancing the digital guest experience and developing additional revenue opportunities across our hotel network.

A MESSAGE FROM DR AHMED JAMALOODEEN, Chairman and President:

DEAR FELLOW SHAREHOLDERS, PROSPECTIVE INVESTORS AND MARKET PARTICIPANTS,

I believe it is important to provide shareholders with a comprehensive understanding of what has been assembled at ProText Mobility, Inc., how the various components connect and the economic significance of our broader corporate strategy.

Over the past several years, we have brought together substantial real-world assets, agricultural production capabilities, proprietary biotechnology, pharmaceutical-related inventory, digital tokenisation infrastructure, institutional financial relationships and international commercial opportunities.

We have also established important corporate reporting, investor-relations and information-technology infrastructure.

These are not disconnected initiatives.

They form an integrated business ecosystem designed to create, enhance, administer and monetise real-world economic assets.

Our strategy has always extended beyond one product, one technology, one token or one transaction.

WE ARE NOT STARTING FROM ZERO.

We have existing assets.

We have established technologies.

We have demonstrated agricultural multiplication.

We have pharmaceutical-related inventory.

We have deployed digital infrastructure.

We have institutional banking relationships.

We have agreed financial arrangements.

We have international commercial relationships developed over decades.

And we have an existing publicly traded company through which qualifying economic opportunities can be developed.

The next stage of our roadmap is focused on translating these components into measurable revenue, profitability and long-term shareholder value.

1. OUR EXISTING REAL-WORLD ASSET FOUNDATION

ProText Mobility’s previously published financial statements already reflect substantial real-world assets.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company reported approximately:

1.9 BILLION AGRICULTURAL SEEDS

125,959,995 MILLIGRAMS OF ACTIVE PHARMACEUTICAL INGREDIENTS.

The contribution also had an estimated fair market value of approximately US$10.71 million at the time.

These figures represent previously disclosed accounting and valuation measures, rather than cash balances or completed monetisation proceeds.

The significance of these assets extends beyond their reported financial values.

They provide an established economic foundation for our biotechnology, agricultural and digital financial infrastructure.

REAL ASSETS UNDERPIN THE BUSINESS.

2. AGRICULTURAL MULTIPLICATION — ADDITIONAL ASSETS THROUGH PRODUCTION

Our seed multiplication agreement was established in October 2023.

Through this arrangement, qualifying seed inventory has undergone planting, germination, harvesting, processing and subsequent return to the Company.

Multiple completed production cycles have been documented in our financial disclosures.

During the first quarter of 2026 alone, the Company recorded an increase of approximately 300 million seeds through its established multiplication programme.

This is an accomplished agricultural activity.

The economic principle is straightforward.

EXISTING BIOLOGICAL ASSETS CAN PRODUCE ADDITIONAL BIOLOGICAL ASSETS.

Our Chairman’s independent agricultural operations and related commercial arrangements provide access to longstanding farming experience, infrastructure and production capabilities.

These resources have been developed over generations.

The relevant assets, permits and contractual relationships are distinguished according to their legal ownership and the Company’s public disclosures.

The multiplication programme demonstrates the productive foundation supporting our asset-development strategy.

But increasing the quantity of assets is only one component.

An equally important component is increasing their commercial value.

3. KETTLE TECHNOLOGY AND NANOTECHNOLOGY — ENHANCING ECONOMIC VALUE

This is where our proprietary biotechnology connects directly with our real-world asset and financial infrastructure.

ProText Mobility’s Kettle technology and live-plant extraction capabilities are established components of our biotechnology platform.

The Company’s relationship with TruLeaf adds complementary nanotechnology and pharmaceutical-related expertise.

These capabilities create pathways for transforming qualifying biological materials into extracts, cannabinoid-related APIs and differentiated formulations.

Nanotechnology provides opportunities to enhance the bioavailability and delivery characteristics of suitable formulations.

The commercial importance of this combination is substantial.

OUR BUSINESS IS NOT LIMITED TO INCREASING THE NUMBER OF PHYSICAL ASSETS.

We also have technological capabilities relevant to increasing the economic value generated from qualifying biological materials.

A raw agricultural input, a refined extract and a specialised pharmaceutical-related formulation can possess substantially different commercial applications and values.

Where processing, quality verification, product performance and market demand support such differences, the resulting economic value can be independently assessed.

Our business therefore incorporates two complementary value-creation mechanisms.

ASSET MULTIPLICATION

Producing additional biological assets through established agricultural processes.

ASSET VALUE ENHANCEMENT

Applying Kettle extraction and complementary nanotechnology to develop commercially differentiated products.

This is a fundamental component of our broader strategy.

WE HAVE THE PHYSICAL ASSETS.

WE HAVE THE TECHNOLOGY.

WE HAVE THE PRODUCTION CAPABILITIES.

These components connect directly with our digital tokenisation infrastructure.

4. TRULEAF — A SEPARATE PHARMACEUTICAL-RELATED ASSET BASE

The TruLeaf API contribution introduced an additional category of physical assets into TXTM’s reported inventory.

It also strengthened the connection between our agricultural activities, biotechnology capabilities and pharmaceutical-related opportunities.

The existing API contribution provides an additional foundation for appropriate commercial applications involving biological materials, specialised extracts and formulated products.

Kettle technology and complementary nanotechnology provide established technological capabilities relevant to this value chain.

TXTM IS NOT SIMPLY A SEED-INVENTORY BUSINESS.

Its broader ecosystem encompasses agricultural production, biotechnology, cannabinoid-related APIs, digital infrastructure and financial applications.

The integration of these capabilities is central to the Company’s identity.

5. THE CONNECTION BETWEEN RWA VALUE AND TOKEN VALUE

One of the most important features of our strategy is the relationship between underlying physical economic value and digital asset representation.

Our existing agricultural multiplication programme has demonstrated the production of additional inventory.

Our biotechnology capabilities provide pathways for enhancing the commercial value of qualifying biological materials.

Our tokenisation infrastructure connects eligible underlying assets with digital financial applications.

This creates two potential mechanisms for increasing the asset value represented within an appropriately structured token programme.

FIRST: Additional independently verified underlying assets.

SECOND: Increased independently supportable value of qualifying underlying assets.

For example, additional verified seed inventory may support further authorised token issuance.

Separately, higher-value commercial outputs may support a revised asset valuation or an additional tokenisation structure, depending upon the legal rights represented.

Changes in underlying economic value can be reflected in the applicable token’s independently determined net asset value where its governing methodology permits.

Such changes do not automatically establish a higher market trading price.

THE VALUE ORIGINATES WITH THE UNDERLYING ECONOMIC ASSETS.

The tokenisation infrastructure provides the mechanism for their digital representation and financial administration.

This principle also extends to other eligible real-world asset classes, including verified environmental assets and carbon credits.

6. SVLT — DEPLOYED DIGITAL ASSET INFRASTRUCTURE

The Seed Vault Token programme is an established component of our ecosystem.

SVLT has been deployed using an ERC-3643 permissioned architecture incorporating identity, compliance and administrative functionality.

The Company’s agricultural seed-tokenisation initiative has already been publicly announced.

The infrastructure has been developed to support the digital representation of qualifying real-world assets.

Its importance lies in connecting tangible economic resources with appropriate verification, governance and institutional financial systems.

SVLT is not being presented as a speculative public token sale.

Its role within our strategy is the digital representation and administration of defined asset-related rights.

The broader tokenisation architecture can also support evaluation of additional qualifying asset classes.

TOKENISATION IS AN ENABLER OF ECONOMIC VALUE — NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR IT.

The business model encompasses two complementary activities.

Qualifying assets owned by the Company and developed through its commercial activities.

THIRD-PARTY ASSET SERVICES

Digital asset administration, tokenisation and related technology services for qualifying third-party asset owners.

Traditional asset-management businesses may generate revenue by managing assets that belong to others.

Our model combines that potential service opportunity with an existing base of physical assets and productive capabilities.

The objective is to generate commercial value from both asset-related activities and financial infrastructure services.

The ownership of third-party assets remains separate from TXTM’s own balance sheet.

8. ABSA — ESTABLISHED INSTITUTIONAL CUSTODY AND AGREED FINANCIAL ARRANGEMENTS

The Chairman’s profile is ready on the system.

ABSA CUSTODY ONBOARDING IS COMPLETE.

THE PROFILE IS READY. THE SVLT WALLET IS READY.

This is a demonstration of the established system and its operation.

In addition, the Chairman confirms that institutional trading and monetisation arrangements have been agreed with ABSA.

THE AGREEMENT STAGE IS NOT BEING DESCRIBED AS AN ASPIRATION.

THE ARRANGEMENTS ARE AGREED. WE ARE EXECUTING NOW.

Institutional custody is an established component of our broader asset-backed financial infrastructure.

THE FOUNDATION IS ESTABLISHED. THE INFRASTRUCTURE IS IN PLACE. EXECUTION CONTINUES.

8A. TXTM COMMON AND PREFERRED STOCK TOKENISATION — SMART CONTRACT COMPLETED

Separate from SVLT, our TXTM equity-tokenisation programme is moving forward with implementation.

The programme encompasses the Chairman’s personally held TXTM common and preferred stock.

THE SMART CONTRACT IS COMPLETE.

Receipt has been confirmed.

DOCUMENTATION SENT. RECEIPT CONFIRMED.

The next step is the deployment walkthrough for the TXTM token.

This programme concerns the digital representation and administration of existing equity-related interests.

It is distinct from SVLT and the tokenisation of agricultural or other physical assets.

Tokenisation of these existing interests does not itself issue additional TXTM common shares or convert the Chairman’s preferred stock into common shares.

The legal and economic rights represented by the tokens will be governed by the applicable transaction documentation, with the underlying ownership records and transfer requirements preserved.

This adds a separate equity-related component to our established digital infrastructure and broader capital-markets programme.

EXISTING COMMON AND PREFERRED STOCK.

SMART CONTRACT COMPLETED.

OWNERSHIP DOCUMENTATION RECEIVED.

DEPLOYMENT WALKTHROUGH NEXT.

9. BNY MELLON, OTHER BANKING INSTITUTIONS AND THE FAMILY OFFICE

Our institutional relationships extend beyond ABSA.

This is a direct BNY relationship and is separate from the ABSA custody initiative.

These relationships have been developed through longstanding commercial and institutional engagement.

WE HAVE THE RELATIONSHIPS.

WE HAVE THE EXPERIENCE.

WE HAVE THE FINANCIAL CONNECTIVITY.

10. INSURANCE WRAPS, PERFORMANCE GUARANTEES AND INSTITUTIONAL MONETISATION

VANCOUVER, BC and GLIL YAM, Israel, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IM Cannabis Corp. (the "Company") (NASDAQ: IMCC) announced changes to its management and board of directors (the "Board"), including the appointment of Ronen Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer and Ohad Melnik as an independent director.

Management Changes

Effective November 19, 2026, the Board appointed Ronen Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, succeeding Oren Shuster, who resigned from that role.

Mr. Zalayet has more than 25 years of experience in financial leadership positions in private and public companies. He has served as Chief Financial Officer of Nexera Technologies Ltd. (formerly Jeffs' Brands Ltd.), a company listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq"), since October 2022. From July 2021 to December 2023, he served as Chief Executive Officer and a director of Shemen Oil and Gas Resources Ltd., a company listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. From July 2025 to June 2026, he served as Chief Financial Officer of Fort Technology Inc., a Canadian company listed on Nasdaq (formerly Impact Acquisition Corp.). From November 2019 to June 2021, Mr. Zalayet served as Chief Financial Officer of Colugo Systems Ltd., and from 2016 to 2020, he served as a consultant, a director and head of the Israeli office of Access Capital Markets Limited. Mr. Zalayet holds a B.A. in Economics and Accounting and an M.B.A. from Tel Aviv University and is a certified public accountant in Israel.

The Board thanks Mr. Shuster for his leadership of the Company since its founding and for his many contributions and welcomes Mr. Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer.

In addition, effective November 19, 2026, Shakked Shuster was appointed as Chief Executive Officer of Focus Medical Herbs Ltd., the Company's Israeli subsidiary through which it operates its medical cannabis business in Israel, succeeding Oren Shuster following his resignation from that role. 

Mr. Shakked Shuster has more than six years of experience in Israel's medical cannabis industry through his work at the Company, spanning product, international sourcing, brand partnerships and marketing. He joined the Company in July 2020 as Product Marketing Lead before taking on the role of Product Manager from 2021 to 2022. In that role, he set the Company's product and quality standards and spent an extended period working with the team at its southern cultivation facility. Beginning in mid-2021, he led the development of the Company's import program, working with Canadian craft producers to establish supply from Canada to Israel. As Head of Product & Marketing from May 2022 to September 2023, he oversaw the product portfolio and the full marketing team. His work focused on expanding the product offering and strengthening international partnerships, including negotiating brand-licensing agreements and launching and developing the brands in the Israeli market. In September 2023, he stepped back from full-time management and continued working with the Company as an independent consultant, supporting business development with Canadian suppliers and exploring opportunities to bring new brands and products into Israel. Since May 2026, he has worked full time in the Company's Israeli operations.

Before joining the Company, Mr. Shakked Shuster served as a product designer in Unit 81, the technology unit of the Special Operations Division of the Israel Defense Forces' Intelligence Directorate, from 2016 to 2019.

Board Changes

Effective November 19, 2026, Oren Shuster resigned as a director of the Company and will continue to serve as a director of the Company's Israeli subsidiaries.

Effective November 19, 2026, Ohad Melnik was appointed to the Board to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Einat Zakariya in September 2026. Mr. Melnik's appointment is subject to the approval of the Israel Medical Cannabis Agency (IMCA). The Board has determined that Mr. Melnik is an independent director under the Nasdaq listing rules.

Mr. Melnik served as a director of Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. from January 2019 to May 2024. He currently serves as an independent consultant on international online payments to the iFOREX Group and as a director of iFOR Fintech Ltd. an Israeli subsidiary of the iFOREX Group, and previously served as a director of the payment methods department and the finance compliance department of iFOREX International Group. He previously served as a director of Peninsula Group Ltd. from 2008 to 2015 and of Jerusalem Technology Investments Ltd. from 2012 to 2015. Mr. Melnik holds a B.A. in Business Administration and an M.B.A. (cum laude) from the College of Management, and is a graduate of the Executive M.S. in Finance program at Baruch College, City University of New York.

About IM Cannabis Corp.

IM Cannabis Corp. (NASDAQ: IMCC) is an international company operating a medical cannabis platform serving patients in Israel.

The Company's ecosystem operates in Israel through its subsidiaries, which import and distribute cannabis to medical patients, leveraging years of proprietary data and patient insights. The Company also operates medical cannabis retail pharmacies and online platforms in Israel that enable the safe delivery and quality control of IMCC's products throughout the value chain.

SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Caliber (Nasdaq: CWD), a real estate-focused alternative asset manager, today published its inaugural investor FAQ at caliberco.com/investors/faq. The FAQ answers 67 questions about Caliber's business model, its two businesses, its plans and objectives, its balance sheet and its stock.

Caliber wrote the FAQ by putting itself in the position of a prospective shareholder and answering the questions it would want answered. Each answer is in plain English and cites the filing or release it comes from and the date of each figure. Two businesses
Caliber is one public company with two businesses. Its real estate investment platform has sponsored, built and managed middle-market real estate since 2009 and produces substantially all of Caliber's revenue today. Its tokenization platform, built around Caliber Tokenization Services, brings tokenization to private real estate funds, starting with the funds Caliber manages, and is designed to be Caliber's growth engine. First-ever expansion of D.C.’s iconic Old Ebbitt Grill opens its doors at 1860 Reston Row Plaza in The Row at Reston Station

RESTON, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Comstock Holding Companies, Inc. (Nasdaq: CHCI) (“Comstock”), a leading real estate company specializing in the development, acquisition, operation, and management of mixed-use, transit-oriented properties and data center developments, today announced the grand opening of Ebbitt House at Reston Station. Located at 1860 Reston Row Plaza in The Row at Reston Station, the 12,000-square-foot restaurant opens its doors to the public today at 11 a.m. and will welcome guests daily. Reservations are now open via EbbittHouse.com and OpenTable.

Named after the original 1856 boarding house that gave rise to the legendary Old Ebbitt Grill, Ebbitt House marks the first-ever expansion of the storied brand outside of downtown D.C. in its 170-year history. Designed as a contemporary evolution of the D.C. landmark, the venue brings the signature Clyde’s Restaurant Group (“CRG”) hospitality, classic American fare, lively bar culture, and renowned raw bar to Northern Virginia’s premier mixed-use, transit-oriented neighborhood.

Ebbitt House features more than 400 seats spread across its 275+ guest dining room, two private dining rooms, and all-season patio. Two indoor bars anchor the main dining areas that are complemented by a dedicated outdoor patio bar. ARLINGTON, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apartments.com, an industry-leading online marketplace of CoStar Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSGP), released its latest U.S. multifamily construction activity update for the third quarter of 2026.

National apartment construction starts totaled about 76,000 units in Q3 2026, down 63% from the peak of nearly 206,000 units in Q1 2022 and the lowest quarterly total since 2012. Over the past 12 months, starts totaled about 342,000 units, the lowest annual pace since 2014 and roughly three-quarters of the units delivered over the same period.

As a result, the pipeline continues to shrink. About 593,000 units were under construction nationwide in the third quarter. That is roughly half the early 2023 peak of nearly 1.2 million and the 14th consecutive quarterly decline, returning the pipeline to mid-2016 levels.

"Developers are still breaking ground on far fewer projects than they're finishing, and that gap is reshaping the supply outlook market by market," said Grant Montgomery, national director of U.S. multifamily analytics at CoStar Group. "In places where starts have pulled back the furthest, the wave of new apartments that defined the past few years is giving way to a much thinner pipeline ahead."

Completions are also easing. About 446,000 units were delivered over the past four quarters, down 22% from a year earlier and 36% below the 2024 peak.

At the market level, New York City has the largest pipeline at about 46,000 units, followed by Dallas-Fort Worth at roughly 32,000. Relative to existing inventory, Miami leads with about 9% of its apartment stock under construction, followed by Charlotte and Fort Lauderdale at more than 6%.

The pullback is especially sharp in Texas, home to three of the six most active markets for apartment starts during the building boom. Combined starts over the past 12 months across Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Austin and San Antonio are down about 42% from a year earlier.

KEY FACTS

  • SUNHARBO® (asundexian) is now available to order for hospitals, health systems and pharmacies in the U.S.
  • SUNHARBO was recently approved by the U.S. FDA to be used in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIH Stroke Scale ≤ 15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA).1

WHIPPANY, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Bayer announced today that SUNHARBO® (asundexian), 50 mg tablets, is now available to order in the United States. Hospitals, health systems and pharmacies have immediate access to order the product for inventory. SUNHARBO is the first approved Factor XIa inhibitor in the U.S. and represents the first in a new class of medicine.1

SUNHARBO is indicated in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIH Stroke Scale ≤ 15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA).1

BAYER EXECUTIVE COMMENTARY
“The swift availability of SUNHARBO reinforces our commitment to patients,” said Nelson Ambrogio, President of Bayer U.S. Pharmaceuticals. “We are proud of the progress Bayer has made in bringing forward a new option for secondary stroke prevention.”

EXPERT COMMENTARY
“I want to see new secondary stroke prevention therapies available to healthcare professionals and their patients as quickly as possible,” said Mike Sharma, M.D., Principal investigator of the Population Health Research Institute (PHRI) OCEANIC-STROKE study, Senior Scientist at PHRI, and Director of the Stroke Program at Hamilton Health Sciences. “Now that SUNHARBO can be ordered for pharmacy inventory in the U.S., let’s recognize that we are taking another great step forward toward that goal.”

To support patients, Bayer is offering several programs designed to facilitate therapy initiation and continuity of care, including co-pay offers and patient education. For more information, visit here: https://www.sunharbosavings.com/.

The list price for SUNHARBO will be $748.50 for a 30-day supply. The list price does not reflect what most health plans or patients will pay. Costs will vary by health plan, and patients’ out-of-pocket costs will depend on their coverage, such as deductibles and copays. The list price may be subject to change without prior notifications.

Bayer is committed to making SUNHARBO accessible. If a patient cannot afford their prescription, Bayer may be able to help. Eligible patients may receive their Bayer prescription medicine at no cost through the Bayer U.S. Patient Assistance Foundation. For more information, please visit www.patientassistance.bayer.us or call to speak with a member of Bayer’s team at 1-866-2BUSPAF (228-7723).

About SUNHARBO® (asundexian)
SUNHARBO is a once-daily, first-in-class, oral Factor XIa inhibitor approved by the U.S. FDA and indicated in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIHSS≤15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA). SUNHARBO is the first approved Factor XIa inhibitor in the U.S. and represents the first medicine in a new class designed to target Factor XIa. SUNHARBO is an inhibitor of Factor XIa. Factor XIa inhibition reduces amplification of thrombin generation. In preclinical models, Factor XIa inhibition targets more pathological clotting (thrombosis) with lesser impact on normal clotting response (hemostasis).1

SUNHARBO was approved based on results from the pivotal Phase 3 OCEANIC-STROKE study where SUNHARBO significantly reduced ischemic stroke in patients after a recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or high-risk transient ischemic attack compared to placebo (6.2% vs. 8.4%; HR 0.74; 95% CI, 0.65–0.84; P<0.0001), both in combination with antiplatelet therapy.1

For additional information about SUNHARBO, healthcare professionals may visit SUNHARBOhcp.com. Please see the full prescribing information.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

CONTRAINDICATIONS and WARNINGS & PRECAUTIONS
None.

ADVERSE REACTIONS
Bleeding

  • The rate of International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis (ISTH) major bleeding was similar between SUNHARBO and placebo groups (1.6 vs. 1.5 per 100 patient-years).
  • The rate of ISTH major bleeding events within 90 days of treatment initiation was 4.5 vs. 3.1 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • In patients planned to receive DAPT, the rate of ISTH major bleeding events was 1.9 vs. 1.5 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • Among patients older than 75 years, the rate of ISTH major bleeding was 2.6 vs. 1.7 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • In the high-risk TIA subgroup, the rate of ISTH major bleeding was 2.9 vs. 1.0 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • The rate of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding was higher in the SUNHARBO compared to placebo group (2.7 vs. 2.1 per 100 patient-years). The majority of GI bleeding events in the SUNHARBO group (74%) were clinically relevant non-major or minor bleeding, and the most frequent bleeding site was of rectal origin.

Diarrhea

  • The most frequently reported (> 3%) adverse reaction in SUNHARBO-treated patients was diarrhea.

Hepatic Enzyme Increased

  • SUNHARBO is associated with elevated hepatic enzymes. Substantial cholestatic liver injury or serious liver injury with jaundice were each reported in less than 0.02% of SUNHARBO-treated patients.

DRUG INTERACTIONS

  • P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrates - Concomitant use of SUNHARBO increased the exposure to digoxin. For digoxin and sensitive P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may increase the risk of adverse reactions, follow the recommendation in their approved product labeling.
  • Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers - Avoid concomitant use with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers, which decreases SUNHARBO exposure and may lead to loss of efficacy.

USE IN SPECIFIC POPULATIONS

Pregnancy

  • There are risks to the mother associated with untreated non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or TIA and risk of bleeding in the mother and fetus or neonate associated with use of anticoagulants during pregnancy.

Lactation

  • Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with SUNHARBO and for 5 days after the last dose due to the potential for serious adverse reactions in nursing infants, including bleeding.

Hepatic Impairment

  • Patients with moderate to severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh B and C) may have intrinsic coagulation abnormalities and use of SUNHARBO in these patients is not recommended.

For additional important risk and use information, please see the full Prescribing Information.

You are encouraged to report side effects or quality complaints of prescription drugs to the FDA. Visit www.fda.gov/medwatch or call 1-800-FDA-1088.

About Bayer’s Stroke Franchise
Bayer is a leader in cardiovascular (CV) and cerebrovascular diseases, with a longstanding legacy of scientific innovation in the prevention and treatment of thrombotic conditions. Building on this heritage, Bayer is advancing innovative approaches to help address unmet needs in stroke, with a focus on the area of secondary stroke prevention and research into new pathways, including Factor XIa. Bayer aims to help shape the future of stroke care with products strategically positioned to help address critical unmet needs and drive significant long-term value. Bayer is working alongside the stroke community to better understand unmet needs and support patients and care partners across the stroke journey.

On May 27, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors approved the launch of the Genius AI Treasury, with a plan to deploy up to US$100 million of initial capital as the first phase of a US$800 million, five-year investment program into companies leading the development of Artificial General Intelligence (“AGI”). SpaceX, which listed on Nasdaq on June 12, 2026 at an IPO valuation of approximately $1.77 trillion, had a market capitalization of approximately $1.95 trillion based on its closing share price on November 18, 2026, more than 50% above the combined SpaceX and xAI valuation at the time of the Company’s investment.

Genius Group believes the benefit of its Treasury strategy will be realized over a long term horizon. By example, over the next five years, analyst revenue forecasts for Anthropic rise from between $52 billion to $53 billion in 2026 through to between $270 billion to $280 billion in 2028[3], and to between $505 billion and $685 billion in 2030[3][7]. Analyst consensus revenue estimates for SpaceX rise from $49.0 billion in 2026 to $181.3 billion in 2027[4], $330.9 billion in 2028[8] and $492.5 billion in 2030[9]. DULUTH, Ga.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Boxlight Corporation (Nasdaq: BOXL) ("Boxlight" or the "Company"), a leading provider of interactive technology solutions, today announced that on November 18, 2026, the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") declared effective the Company's registration statement on Form S-1, satisfying a key condition to the funding of the second tranche of its Series D Preferred Stock financing and to the use of its equity line of credit of up to $15 million. The registration statement covers the resale by the selling stockholders named in the prospectus of up to 47,466,613 shares of Class A common stock, including shares issuable under the Company's Series D Preferred Stock and equity line of credit.

The second tranche would provide the Company with $2.0 million in gross proceeds and bring total gross proceeds from the Series D financing to $7.5 million. Funding of the second tranche remains subject to the satisfaction of the remaining closing conditions. The Company also expects to begin using its up to $15 million equity line of credit, subject to the terms and conditions of the equity purchase agreement. The Company intends to use the net proceeds to reduce debt under its senior credit facility with WhiteHawk Finance LLC and for working capital and general corporate purposes.

On November 18, 2026, the Company received notice from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") that, based on stockholders' equity of approximately $1.9 million reported for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, it does not meet the $2.5 million minimum stockholders' equity requirement of Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). Because the Company remains under a one-year panel monitor following a September 2, 2026 decision of the Nasdaq Hearings Panel (the "Panel"), Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Department (the "Staff") issued a delisting determination rather than a period to regain compliance. Key Terms

form s-1regulatory
A Form S-1 is the registration filing a company submits to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission when it plans to offer stock to the public, most commonly for an initial public offering. Think of it as the company’s full disclosure packet or blueprint: it contains audited financials, business description, management background, risk factors and details of the offering, giving investors the information needed to judge the company’s financial health and potential risks before buying shares.
equity line of creditfinancial
An equity line of credit is a loan that allows homeowners to borrow money against the value of their property, similar to having a flexible credit card secured by their home. It matters to investors because it provides a way for property owners to access cash for various needs, which can influence real estate markets and overall economic activity. This type of credit offers ongoing borrowing capacity, making it a valuable financial tool for those with significant property equity.
senior credit facilityfinancial
A senior credit facility is a large loan or revolving line of credit that a company borrows from banks or lenders and that has first claim on the company’s cash and assets if the business runs into financial trouble. Think of it as the “first in line” debt with stronger repayment priority and usually stricter rules, so investors watch it because its size, cost and covenants affect a company’s cash flow, risk profile and the value of equity and other creditors.
stockholders' equityfinancial
Stockholders' equity is the portion of a company's assets that belongs to its owners after all debts and obligations are paid; think of it as the value left for shareholders if the company sold everything and paid off what it owes. Investors watch it because it shows the company's net worth, indicates how much of growth is funded by owners versus debt, and helps assess financial health and the potential for future dividends or stock value increases — like the equity in a house after the mortgage is settled.

NEW YORK, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lanvin Group Holdings Limited (NYSE: LANV, the "Company" or "Lanvin Group"), a global luxury fashion group, today announced that it will hold its annual general meeting of the shareholders (the "AGM") virtually through a live webcast and teleconference on December 18, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. EST. The AGM will serve as an open forum for shareholders to engage with the Board of Directors and the executive management of the Company, and will be convened to consider and, if thought fit, pass the proposed resolutions set out in the notice of the AGM (the "Notice of AGM"). The Notice of AGM and the proxy card for the AGM are available on the Company's website at https://ir.lanvin-group.com. 

The Board of Directors fully supports the Proposed Resolutions and recommends that shareholders vote in favor of it as set out in the Notice of AGM.

Only holders of record of the Company's ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.000001 each at the close of business on November 17, 2026 Eastern Standard Time are entitled to receive notice of, to attend and to vote at the AGM or any adjournment or postponement thereof.

The Company has filed its annual report on Form 20-F, including its audited financial statements, for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (the "Form 20-F"), with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The Form 20-F can be accessed on the Company's website at https://ir.lanvin-group.com and on the SEC's website at http://www.sec.gov.
